firstPlayerRule: Determine the start player randomly. The last player (to the right of the start player) receives the Praefectus Magnus card.
clarifications: Players take turns in clockwise order, each playing one personality card per turn.

Page 1, Game setup: ‘After randomly determining the start player, the last player (player to the right of the start player) receives the Praefectus Magnus.’ Game flow: turns go clockwise. The material list (Imperium/Italia board, 65 personality cards, Praefectus Magnus card) and final scoring by personality gods identify Mac Gerdts’ Concordia base game (BGG 124361).
